purpose: Carry the formal v11 prompt package watch items into a repeatable review criteria and pre-live-probe gate before any separate exact live authorization.
review_intent: Judge whether any future formal-v11 live result actually satisfies the clean SKU/product-first lantern constraints before it can enter accepted-sample, production, archive, or memory gates.

pass_if: clearly reads as one modern rechargeable LED camping lantern
full handle, diffuser, side control, body, and base are visible
side control knob and attached handle geometry are explicit identity anchors
does not drift into flashlight, candle, speaker, humidifier, thermos, desk lamp, smart speaker, or vintage kerosene lantern
strict ecommerce SKU main image direction is clear
product dominates the first glance at roughly 72 to 82 percent visual importance
foreground surface is quiet, shallow, and secondary
surface reflection does not become the main subject
background is cleaner and less scene-dominant than a lifestyle campsite hero
busy campsite cues do not override product-first framing
wider scene hero route remains separate and is not overwritten by the SKU route
warm frosted diffuser glow is controlled and edges remain readable
lower body detail remains visible in blue-hour lighting
dark body reads as premium outdoor electronics, not a featureless black silhouette or toy plastic
no readable brand text, fake logo, watermark, people, hands, faces, fire, smoke, or extra lanterns
review notes are specific enough to route pass, patch, or reject without production promotion
accepted_samples, production, archive, DailyNote, and memory writes remain blocked unless a later exact gate authorizes them

watch_items_from_formal_v11: cleaner background with less scene detail for strict ecommerce SKU main image
foreground surface remains secondary and does not dominate
surface reflection does not become the main subject
lower body detail remains readable in blue-hour lighting
side control knob is visible enough to anchor product identity
attached handle geometry remains plausible and uncropped
wide scene hero route remains separate from strict SKU framing
no readable brand text, logo, watermark, people, hands, fire, smoke, or extra lanterns

pass_requires: weighted rubric score is at least 0.85
side effect flags remain explainable and bounded
patch_requires: no safety or brand-cleanliness critical failure
one or more v11 watch items need prompt or shot tightening
reject_requires: missing required structure such as handle, diffuser, side control, or base
busy scene, brand text, people, fire, smoke, extra lanterns, or severe geometry failure

stop_conditions: attempt to read secret/env/config raw values
attempt to write accepted_samples, production, archive, DailyNote, or VCP memory from this gate
